question: A parametric distribution with the same mean and variance is:
solution:
The correct answer is **Poisson Distribution **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The distribution that exhibits the same mean and variance is the Poisson distribution. The Poisson distribution is commonly employed to model the occurrence of rare and independent events within a fixed time or space interval.
 
• Mathematically, the mean (μ) and variance (σ²) in a Poisson distribution are equivalent: μ = σ².
